name: 1-methyl-3-propyl-4-(p-chlorophenyl)piperidine
summary: 1-Methyl-3-propyl-4-(p-chlorophenyl)piperidine is a drug developed by a team led by Alan Kozikowski, which acts as a potent dopamine reuptake inhibitor, and was developed as a potential therapeutic agent for the treatment of cocaine addiction. As with related compounds such as nocaine, it is a structurally simplified derivative of related phenyltropane compounds.

pharmacology.text: 1-Methyl-3-propyl-4-(p-chlorophenyl)piperidine is a drug developed by a team led by Alan Kozikowski, which acts as a potent dopamine reuptake inhibitor, and was developed as a potential therapeutic agent for the treatment of cocaine addiction. The rearranged structural isomer 2-[1-(4-chlorophenyl)butyl]piperidine is also a potent inhibitor of dopamine reuptake.

uses.text: 1-Methyl-3-propyl-4-(p-chlorophenyl)piperidine is a drug developed by a team led by Alan Kozikowski, which acts as a potent dopamine reuptake inhibitor, and was developed as a potential therapeutic agent for the treatment of cocaine addiction.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Dopamine reuptake inhibitors such as cocaine can cause a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, anxiety and a strong urge to keep using.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。古柯鹼等多巴胺再吸收抑制劑可能造成心跳加快、血壓升高、焦慮，以及強烈想持續使用的衝動。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。古柯碱等多巴胺再吸收抑制剂可能造成心跳加快、血压升高、焦虑，以及强烈想持续使用的冲动。

fact.en: It is a slimmed down version of the phenyltropanes, the cocaine related family, keeping the key parts but dropping the extra bridging ring.
fact.zh: 它是苯基托烷類（與古柯鹼相關的家族）的簡化版本，保留了關鍵結構，但去掉了額外的橋環。
fact.zhHans: 它是苯基托烷类（与古柯碱相关的家族）的简化版本，保留了关键结构，但去掉了额外的桥环。
